title: Vinyl Sorceress and Serpent
description: A mystical female figure with white hair and ornate armor floats above a giant spinning vinyl record, casting a swirling blue magical energy stream filled with glowing runes. The scene includes three floating orbs depicting a waterfall, a man in a suit, and a coiled snake, with a large scaly black serpent emerging from the record's surface onto a sandy ground.
